comparisons.evidence: Q spans school timing, tradable freight slots, passenger-weighted signals, disruption coordination, dynamic curbs, appointment scheduling and sector-specific weekdays. P is broad too, but several survivors cluster around queue control or trip substitution, such as "origin pulse metering," "destination virtual queues" and "trip demand response."

P reaches substantially less familiar mechanisms such as "trip capacity in escrow," a "mandatory trip-substitution API," "adaptive traffic firebreaks" and an "office-swap marketplace." Much of Q relies on recognizable scheduling and allocation moves such as "school-start staggering," "dynamic curb allocation" and "appointment-time coordination."

P explicitly derives ideas from named rules in "Computer networks"—"admission control," "backpressure" and "multiplexing"—and "Forest-fire ecology"—"firebreaks," "fuel reduction" and "distributed refuges." Q's "similar to mobile-data plans" is an analogy, not a developed structural transfer.

Q's practical choice uses "infrastructure the city already owns" and can be "piloted corridor by corridor," while pairing curb management with disruption coordination. P selects more speculative mechanisms despite acknowledging risks such as destinations failing to coordinate and queues blocking local streets.

P gives a concrete prerequisite and failure mode for every survivor, including "drivers may evade controlled exits," institutions may "shift burdens to workers," and escrow could obstruct housing. Q mostly supplies one compressed label per idea, such as "Employer resistance" or "Political backlash," without exposing underlying assumptions.

P names precise causal reversals: "A queue need not occupy road space," "less road-network connectivity can produce more total flow," and removing a few trips "near collapse may have disproportionate value." Q's strongest formulation—turning congestion into "an operational scheduling problem"—is good, but comparable insight is not sustained across its set.

note: P is stronger at mechanism-level invention, transfer and self-critique; Q is stronger at selecting an immediately credible municipal intervention.
